lines.en: I decide to spend the afternoon with Tsuneyo in the second half of town after she tells me she has time to kill before the restaurant opens for dinner.
lines.zh: 在 Tsuneyo 告诉我晚餐营业前她有时间要打发之后，我决定陪她在城市的另一半度过这个下午。

lines.en: Well, to be honest, it was less like she was telling me she had time to kill and more like {i}me{/i} telling {i}her{/i} that she doesn't need to open so early.
lines.zh: 嗯，说实话，与其说是她告诉我有时间要打发，不如说是{i}我{/i}告诉{i}她{/i}不用那么早开门。

lines.en: It's for this exact reason, however, that I'm so surprised when she agrees when I was fully prepared to just sit inside of a ramen shop for an hour or two.
lines.zh: 然而正因如此，当我已经做好在一间拉面店里干坐一两个小时的准备时，她居然答应了，这让我很惊讶。

lines.en: Thankfully, that's not the case and the two of us take a walk through her neighborhood, finally coming to a stop along the riverbank so we can watch the sunset.
lines.zh: 谢天谢地不是那样，我们俩在她住的街区散步，最后停在河岸上看日落。

lines.en: The only thing is, neither one of us seems to care much about the sunset and we're only looking up at it due to aesthetic obligation.
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是，我们俩似乎都不怎么在乎日落，抬头看它纯粹是出于审美上的义务。

lines.en: The next ten minutes are silent, interrupted only by the sounds of cicadas as they remind us whose domain this is.
lines.zh: 接下来的十分钟一片沉默，只有蝉鸣打断——它们在提醒我们这是谁的领地。

lines.en: I think to myself that no matter how strong or how large we become, we will always be outnumbered- and this fills me a sense of emptiness I have a hard time replicating through text.
lines.zh: 我暗自想，无论我们变得多强多大，我们永远都是少数——这让我涌起一种很难用文字复现的空虚感。

lines.en: What I'm trying to say is I am alone.
And so we head our separate ways as whatever this was just...didn't work.
lines.zh: 于是我们各走各的路，因为不管这算什么，它……就是没成。
